name: repoheat
problem: GitHub shows a total, so you miss the repo that is taking off
promise: See which of your repos are heating up, in your terminal

features.title: Stars gained, repo by repo
features.detail: Stars in the last 2 and 7 days for every repo you own, plus a 30-day chart

features.title: A viral score you can read
features.detail: 0 to 100, with every point explained: momentum, acceleration, spike, freshness

features.title: Works on any public profile
features.detail: Point it at any user or organization, not just your own account
